svg.text: Phase 17A Visual Grammar Test Sheet · v0.3
One visual system for evidence → scenario → canon → sketch. Provisional styling; semantics are the test.
Status answers: what kind of claim is this?
Line meaning is separate from E / S / C / K.
Real geography and explanatory abstraction never masquerade as each other.
Map = where. Schematic = how. Pair them when process needs geographic context.
Persistence silhouette: show what survives, what is modified, what is added.
Accrete · retrofit · repair · reuse; avoid default clean-sheet replacement.
Internal loops stay visible — and so do the boundaries.
Do not collapse residual → resource → usable input.
Labor · regulation · capital · maintenance remain outside dependencies.
Function first; gadgets last. Maintenance is visible.
No energy / service / repair / authority / access story?
The same grammar must survive four very different spreads.
Pre-freeze tests: grayscale · small-size · 5-second hierarchy · epistemic clarity · arrow semantics · static-before-motion · reduced-motion · production cost.
Provisional visual language — do not treat colors, fonts, or strokes as frozen.
